Laboratoriedatabasen is the national Danish register of laboratory tests. It serves as a foundational data source for healthcare quality monitoring in Denmark, specifically by supplying data to the Danish National Indicator Database (DANIBD) [^src1]. Within the context of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) care, Laboratoriedatabasen provides critical measurements for fecal calprotectin (F-calpro) using the specific laboratory code NPU19717 [^src1]. This data is essential for evaluating national quality indicators, such as the systematic follow-up of patients receiving biological and small molecule (BMSL) treatments [^src1].

The use of Laboratoriedatabasen is part of a broader national initiative to ensure evidence-based, registry-driven quality monitoring of IBD treatment [^src1]. Despite its importance, the 2023 DANIBD annual report notes ongoing challenges regarding coding uncertainties in the National Patient Register (LPR) and highlights a need for better data integration from the National Patient Register (SMR) and local laboratory codes to ensure comprehensive and accurate reporting [^src1].
